lines.say: My own sister looked at me like a stranger.
My sister did not know my name. Neither did my boss.
My badge blinked faster. The edges of my hands went grey.
I ran to the red phone. The Registrar answered before it rang.
He said, I can keep you seen. Sit in the front row. Be my witness.
I asked what I would have to watch.
The ones who run Level Nine, he said. They have forgotten what they built.
